children: According to Sina Finance, on September 5, Russia's Defense Ministry said Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship at the port of Chornomorsk in Odesa region carrying military-technical supplies provided by Western countries to the Ukrainian armed forces. It also said Russian forces hit a company in Boryspil, Kyiv region, that produces ammunition and explosives for Ukraine's security agencies.

title: Russia Says It Hit Cargo Ship Carrying Western Military Supplies to Ukraine
